description: After fz-bin.10 fixes transport shape ownership for fixtures2/behavior/enum_predicate_search.fz, both fz2 interp and fz2 run reach native lowering and fail with error[artifact/incomplete-semantic-plan]: compiler2 native lowering for root 0: native callable materialization found no native boundary among CallableId fact boundaries [] for CallableId(...). The fixture uses Enum predicate/search callbacks that stay direct-callable in transport, but native callable materialization is trying to select a native boundary anyway. Investigate native callable materialization's direct-vs-first-class boundary selection before re-enabling enum_predicate_search execution.
title: Native callable materialization requires boundary for direct Enum predicate callback
